budget_items.topic: ACO budget (292 - Animal Control) FY2013-FY2016 table
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager presented the current ACO budget table; the printed table is OCR-garbled and column assignment is uncertain, with totals as legible.
budget_items.quote: ms. lafleur presented the current budget for aco

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed changes described as cost neutral; ACO paid a stipend of $1000 per month, about twelve hours per month at $20 per hour, with no change.
budget_items.quote: the proposed changes to implement would be cost neutral. the aco is paid by a stipend of $1000 per month averaging to about twelve hours per month at $20 per hour.

budget_items.topic: ACO personal funds and budget increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: ACO said she often uses personal money to care for dogs; she said the budget would have to be increased if someone else takes the job. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the budget will have to be increased if someone else picks up the job.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: ACO said she will charge the town a per-day fee for dog care, though the actual cost is usually more.
budget_items.quote: she will charge the town $3 per day for care

budget_items.topic: Passios School operating and demolition cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities Director reported the annual operating cost and the estimated demolition cost of Passios School.
budget_items.quote: it typically costs around $200,000 per year to operate passios. it would cost approximately one million dollars to demolish it.

budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Middle School renovation option
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Option 1 renovation estimated cost reported as $22 million.
budget_items.quote: this would cost an estimated $22 million for asbestos abatement, roof repair, hvac, window replacement and electrical work.

budget_items.topic: Energy rebates for new middle/high school
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities Director pursuing rebates from Unitil and National Grid; MSBA to receive a share of the rebates.
budget_items.quote: msba will receive 53% of the rebates.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer Commission said final pavement and betterment assessment will begin in spring; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: final pavement and betterment assessment will begin in the spring.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School construction, payroll, accounts payable and payroll deductions warrants presented for signatures.
budget_items.quote: a warrant for school construction in the amount of $3,053,290.84, a payroll warrant in the amount of $684,778.10, an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $795,252.63 and a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $143, 331.24 were presented for signatures.
